body.zh-Hant: 米克拉斯1882至1890年就讀塞滕施泰滕的修道院文理中學，其後在維也納攻讀歷史、日耳曼語文與地理。1895年通過中學與實科中學教師資格考試後進入教職，先後在的里雅斯特、摩拉維亞的普羅斯捷約夫與下奧地利的霍恩任教。他已加入基督教社會黨，主要在瓦爾德菲爾特爾地區從事政治活動；1905年出任霍恩文理中學校長。
body.en: Miklas attended the Stiftsgymnasium in Seitenstetten from 1882 to 1890 and then studied history, German studies and geography in Vienna. In 1895, after passing the teaching examination for Gymnasien and Realschulen, he entered school service, teaching in Trieste, Prossnitz in Moravia and Horn in Lower Austria. By then he had joined the Christian Social Party and was politically active mainly in the Waldviertel; in 1905 he became director of the Gymnasium in Horn.

1895 trat er – nach Ablegung der Lehramtsprüfung

in den Schuldienst ein (Triest, Proßnitz/Mähren und Horn/Niederösterreich)

heading.en: Imperial Reichsrat and the new state of 1918

body.zh-Hant: 1907年帝國議會選舉後，他作為基督教社會黨代表進入眾議院，1908年起並為下奧地利邦議會成員。多瑙君主國瓦解後，1918至1919年他是下奧地利臨時邦議會與（全奧地利）國務委員會的成員。臨時國民議會執行委員會1918年10月31日決定以巴本堡盾徽的紅白紅為新奧地利國色，此議出自他的提案。
body.en: After the Reichsrat elections of 1907 he entered the Abgeordnetenhaus as a representative of the Christian Socials, and from 1908 he also sat in the Lower Austrian Landtag. After the collapse of the Danubian monarchy he was in 1918/19 a member of the Provisional Landesversammlung of Lower Austria and of the all-Austrian Staatsrat. The decision of the executive committee of the Provisional National Assembly of 31 October 1918 to take the red-white-red of the Babenberg shield as the state colours of the new Austria goes back to his motion.

citations.quote: Nach den Reichsratswahlen 1907 zog er
als Vertreter der Christlichsozialen in das Abgeordnetenhaus ein
gehörte seit 1908 auch dem Niederösterr. Landtag an
Nach dem Zusammenbruch der Donaumonarchie
war M. 1918/19 Mitglied der Provisorischen Landesversammlung
von Niederösterreich und des (gesamtösterr.) Staatsrates
Der Beschluß des Vollzugsausschusses der Provisorischen Nationalversammlung
als Staatsfarben des entstehenden neuen Österreich
die Farben desbabenberg. Bindenschilds
(rot-weiß-rot) zu nehmen
geht auf seinen Antrag zurück

heading.zh-Hant: 文化次官與國民議會議長

body.zh-Hant: 1919年2月選出制憲國民議會後，他任內政與教育國務廳的文化事務次官，先屬倫納的基督教社會黨與社會民主黨聯合政府，其後至1920年屬邁爾內閣。他是制憲國民議會（1918/19）成員，之後為國民議會議員（1919至1928年），1923至1928年並任國民議會第一議長。
body.en: After the elections to the Constituent National Assembly in February 1919 he served as Under-Secretary for Culture in the State Office for Home Affairs and Education, first in the Christian Social-Social Democratic coalition government of Renner and then, until 1920, in the Mayr cabinet. He was a member of the Constituent National Assembly (1918/19) and then of the Nationalrat (1919-28), where in 1923-28 he was also First President.

citations.quote: Nach den Wahlen in die Konstituierende Nationalversammlung vom Februar 1919
als Unterstaatssekretär für Kultus im Staatsamt für Inneres und Unterricht

dann bis 1920 dem Kabinett Mayr an

bzw. des Nationalrats (1919–28)
in dem er 1923-28 auch die Funktion des Ersten Präsidenten innehatte

heading.en: Federal president and the authoritarian turn

body.zh-Hant: 1928年聯邦大會選他為聯邦總統，1931年再度確認他任期四年。1933年3月議會議事規則危機中，他拒絕接受多爾富斯政府的辭職，間接確認了政府的措施，也未運用重啟國民議會的可能。他拒絕加入祖國陣線，未簽署1934年5月的「等級國家」憲法，卻因同意授權法使其形式上可行。1935年之後他仍留任。
body.en: In 1928 the Bundesversammlung elected him Federal President and in 1931 he was confirmed in office again for four years. In the standing-orders crisis of March 1933 he did not accept the resignation of the Dollfuss government and thereby indirectly confirmed its measure, and did not use his means of reactivating the Nationalrat. He refused to join the Fatherland Front and did not sign the 'corporative' constitution of May 1934, but by consenting to the so-called Enabling Act he made it formally possible. He remained in office after 1935.

blieb er allerdings auch nach 1935 weiterhin im Amt

body.zh-Hant: 1938年3月11日，在德國的強大壓力與舒施尼格被迫辭職之後，他才同意任命國家社會主義者賽斯-英夸特為聯邦總理，卻拒絕簽署《合併法》，理由是他曾宣誓維護「獨立的奧地利國」。3月13日他把聯邦總統的職能移交給賽斯-英夸特，形式上也等於完成辭職。
body.en: On 11 March 1938, only under massive German pressure and after Schuschnigg's forced resignation, he agreed to appoint the National Socialist Seyss-Inquart as Federal Chancellor, but refused to sign the Anschluss law because he had sworn an oath for an independent state of Austria. On 13 March 1938 he transferred the functions of Federal President to Seyss-Inquart, which formally completed his resignation.

heading.zh-Hant: 執政委員會與當選總統

body.zh-Hant: 薩阿韋德拉是律師、記者與作家。1920年7月，他成為執政委員會的首腦。1921年1月，他當選總統。他從老牌政治人物丹尼爾·薩拉曼卡手中奪得了所屬政黨的領導權。
body.en: Saavedra was a lawyer, journalist and author. In July 1920 he became head of a governing junta. In January 1921 he was elected president. He captured the leadership of his party from Daniel Salamanca.

body.zh-Hant: 他的任期風波不斷，卻也有實績，包括首批社會與勞工立法，以及通往阿根廷的直達鐵路。他被視為玻利維亞最強勢的文人總統之一。1925年9月他卸任，把職位交給參議院議長費利佩·塞貢多·古斯曼。其後他以技術理由宣告選舉無效，改推埃爾南多·西萊斯·雷耶斯接任總統。
body.en: His presidency was stormy but had solid achievements, including the first social and labor legislation and direct rail links to Argentina. He is considered one of Bolivia's strongest civilian presidents. He left office in September 1925, handing it to Senate president Felipe Segundo Guzmán. A year later he had the election annulled on a technicality and imposed Hernando Siles Reyes as his successor.

body.zh-Hant: 穆罕默德五世（Mehmed V Reşad）1844年生於伊斯坦堡。德國國家圖書館的規範檔把同為奧斯曼帝國蘇丹的阿卜杜勒哈米德二世與穆拉德五世列為他的兄弟。
body.en: Mehmed V Reşad was born in Istanbul in 1844. The German National Library authority file gives Abdulhamid II and Murad V, both Ottoman sultans, as his brothers.

heading.en: The First World War and foreign marshal ranks

body.zh-Hant: 規範檔的歷史資訊欄記有1914年與德意志帝國締結針對俄國的防禦同盟，以及站在同盟國一方參戰。1916年他獲德意志帝國授予名譽陸軍元帥，1918年獲奧匈帝國授予元帥頭銜。
body.en: The authority file's historical note lists for 1914 a defensive alliance with the German Reich against Russia and entry into the war on the side of the Central Powers. In 1916 the German Reich made him an honorary field marshal, and in 1918 Austria-Hungary gave him the rank of field marshal.

heading.en: Birth, kin and death in the BnF record

body.zh-Hant: 根據法國國家圖書館的人名權威檔，穆罕默德五世生於1844年11月2日，出生地為伊斯坦堡。同一筆記錄寫他是阿卜杜勒邁吉德一世之子，也是阿卜杜勒哈米德二世的弟弟。他在阿卜杜勒哈米德二世被廢黜後繼位，擔任奧斯曼蘇丹的時間記為1909年至1918年。該記錄記他於1918年7月3日在伊斯坦堡逝世。
body.en: According to the BnF authority record, Mehmed V was born in Istanbul on 2 November 1844. The record calls him a son of Abdülmecid I and a brother of Abdülhamid II. He succeeded Abdülhamid II after the latter's deposition, and is recorded as Ottoman sultan from 1909 to 1918. The record gives his death in Istanbul on 3 July 1918.
